owner.name: Rohan Sharma
owner.quote: I still remember 9th Nov, 2022, my first class. My intro was, “Good morning to all my brothers and my dear girlfriends.” Did countless kands, found two chaotic but real friendships, and our losers trio kept saying, “tauba tauba ye kya gndi si jgh me aa gye hain hum.” But now, we can't even say this. Life moved on. Grateful of all the things we did. Apologies to those who got hurt.

testimonials.name: Suraj Kumar
testimonials.quote: Life moved fast. 4 years felt like 4 days. Friends made my life hell & heaven. Still single. Grateful for every moment, every memory, every idiot I met. Wouldn't change a thing.

testimonials.name: Akansha
testimonials.quote: 15th Nov-The day when My hostel life began with the greatest person I met that day. From first day to last day we were together and then 23rd nov- entry of our mad girl who always being in the mood of attacking but she is emotional too & kid of our family. Here, I got a new family for forever ♾️. I am glad to be the part of this family..🥰🥰.

testimonials.name: Sneha Mausam
testimonials.quote: 7th Nov made me regret this college, but my ground floor idiots made it worth surviving. I still hate this place, just not the people I gained here. Hope they remember me too for their next chapter because I will.

testimonials.name: Pankhuri
testimonials.quote: 23ʳᵈ 𝑵𝒐𝒗 ➝ Adventure Begins. This college gave me painful lessons, beautiful memories, and friends who turned into family ♾️. The hostel became home — full of love, chaos, and a few toxic relatives too. Rude to faculties, but forever a soft-hearted drama queen for my people ♡. ❝No matter where life takes us, a part of my heart will always belong here.❞

testimonials.name: Archana
testimonials.quote: I don’t remember the date I came to hostel, but I clearly remember who gave the biggest betrayal and who turned everything into beautiful memories after that. If I built anything here, it’s the most amazing tripmates and unforgettable moments. 🤭✨

testimonials.name: Aman Kashyap
testimonials.quote: After consecutively failing many exams, topped NPTEL out of nowhere. My friends never let me to have any girlfriend, specially the creator of this app. But we made countless memories, from exploring the abandoned areas to getting ourself killed at random places for absolute nonsense.

testimonials.name: Khushi
testimonials.quote: 15th Nov started with pure chaos, and the urge to leave, but somewhere along these four years, this place became home. The cutie 🫠 I started my journey with 🤍 n then the one we adopted 😂 became my soul, everyone else became family. I hope a part of me stays alive here 🤞

testimonials.name: Shivani Priya
testimonials.quote: Started college on 7th Nov with fear and confusion, ended it with memories I never expected. From sleepless hostel nights to laughing with friends over nothing, these four years quietly became the best chapter of life ✨

testimonials.name: Nishu Bharti
testimonials.quote: Never had a huge circle, but the few people I found made these 4 years memorable. From silent moments to chaotic memories, every lesson and bond became special. My bubble was small, but you guys always had a place in it.

testimonials.name: Riya Verma
testimonials.quote: In my 4 years of BTech journey, I experienced everything good and bad that could happen... I made quite a few friends and created many memories...  Also, I got to know the real world and the real people (in some not-so-great ways, you know)... But among all this, the most interesting part is that I had an incident that completely changed my thinking and personality and I just want that incident to be by my side forever... So I can say that my college life wasn't so bad after all... It was fun, a little bit exciting, and beautiful. ❤️
